info.title: Studium API
info.description: API for browsing the Parisiense Studium prosopography database. Currently in development and DEMO mode. Browse data: studium.vincentpoupet.fr

get.description: Returns a welcome message with the API version.
Serves the API documentation HTML page.
Returns a JSON resource file by name.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Name of the JSON file (without extension)

post.description: Authenticate a user with email and password, returns a JWT token.
Create a new user. Admin only.

get.description: Returns all users. Authenticated users only.
Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Initialize or reset the password for a specific user. Admin only.

delete.description: Delete a user by ID. Admin only.

get.description: Retrieve all prosopography records stored in the database (40k+). Supports pagination via query parameters.

post.description: Create a new prosopography record. Admin only.
Initialize the prosopography reference sequence counter. Authenticated users only.

get.description: Get the current value of the reference sequence counter. Authenticated users only.
Full-text search across prosopography records. Supports pagination and format selection (json, csv, txt).

post.description: Search prosopographies using structured criteria. Supports pagination and format selection (json, csv, txt, pdf).
Initialize graph labels for prosopography visualization.

get.description: Retrieve all prosopography records starting with the given letter.

200.description: Records starting with the given letter

get.description: Retrieve all prosopography record IDs. Authenticated users only.
Retrieve a prosopography record by its reference number (not technical ID). Supports raw text format.

delete.description: Delete a prosopography record by its reference. Admin only.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Reference of the prosopography record to delete

post.description: Parse a prosopography record from plain text format.

get.description: Retrieve a manuscript record by its number.

post.description: Create a new manuscript record. Authenticated users only.
Import a list of manuscripts. Authenticated users only.

get.description: Retrieve all draft prosopography records. Supports pagination.
Retrieve a draft prosopography record by its reference. Supports raw text format.

delete.description: Delete a draft prosopography record by its reference. Admin only.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Reference of the draft to delete

post.description: Create a new draft prosopography record from plain text. Authenticated users only.

post.summary: Update or create draft from text
post.description: Update an existing draft or create a new one from plain text. Authenticated users only.
Publish a draft to the main prosopography collection. Admin only.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Reference of the draft to publish

get.description: Retrieve all prosopography record IDs. Admin only.

post.description: Trigger a full database reindex. Admin only.
Trigger a full backup of the prosopography collection. Admin only.
Create a new MongoDB dump of the Studium database. Admin only.

get.description: List all available database dump files. Admin only.
Download a specific database dump file.

post.description: Re-index a prosopography record by re-parsing its raw text. Admin only.
Re-index geographic manuscript data for a prosopography record. Admin only.
Clear all application logs. Admin only.
